The 1-2 star reviews are highly detailed and credible, describing specific failures (technicians not cleaning, unresponsiveness, upsell pressure). The 5-star reviews are also detailed and name-specific employees. The Yelp/Google discrepancy is typical for the industry and reflects platform biases, not review fraud.
authentic_signals: Specific technician names and project details
Varied writing styles and emotional authenticity
Mix of praise and detailed constructive criticism
Consistent complaint themes across multiple reviewers
complaint_patterns: Project delays and poor subcontractor oversight
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.8) and Yelp (3.2). This is a known pattern where Yelp often attracts more critical reviews and filters positive ones, while Google reviews are more accessible and commonly used for service businesses.

reviews.text: Our pool has never looked better with Josh and Integrity Pools. We used them for tile replacement and then for comprehensive weekly cleaning. Excellent work. Josh leaves a written report on our patio after every visit detailing his work. Price is reasonable - less than our former company and they do more work. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Kim Caston

reviews.text:
Wanna come swim in my pool? No. No one would. Integrity Pools started off strong and then has progressively gotten worse over time. I had high hopes, however, when you can’t control algae, it makes me wonder what else is being skipped over.

My video cameras showed employees emptying baskets and then leaving. No water chemical check. I complained and they changed the service tech. Got better, and then the pool water smelled and I called again. They changed the pool tech again and the smell went away. One time, I watched a pool tech check the Polaris pool cleaner and the bag had a huge hole in it. Not one pool tech ever wrote in their notes that the bag needed to be replaced. I can’t tell you how many pool techs I’ve been through.

Not much has changed and I’ve given them so many chances.

The last tech told me I could get a free dirt vacuum if I leave a five star review. (Which I thought was supposed to be done once a month):

“Hi this is Thomas from integrity pools if you leave a 5 star review with my name in it by the time I get to your pool you get a free dirt vacuum if you’re interested no cost to you”

And yes, I was out of town and the gate was locked last week so the tech couldn’t get to the pool. However, if the pool chemicals were being checked and balanced on a regular basis, there wouldn’t be this amount of algae.

So I ask you…Is this worthy of a five star review? No. It’s not.

Looking for a weekly pool service you can trust? Look elsewhere.
reviews.author: Scott Kakacek

reviews.text:
After using several different pool service companies over the last 5 years, I have never felt compelled to leave any of them a favorable review until now.  After a very high wind storm a couple days ago, our pool was covered with leaves and debris.  Georgia, our regular service tech, went above and beyond cleaning our pool today. This was her regular weekly service call that required her to work much harder and more diligent than normal resulting in my pool never looking so good!  So, my thanks, praise and congratulations to Georgia for a job extremely well done!
I've been using Integrity Pool service for about 3 months and have been more than satisfied with their responsiveness, professionalism and most of all their competence.
reviews.author: Phil Malone

reviews.text: Have used them for 5 years and have given them many chances. When there is an issue with , it’s usually guess work and they just start replacing things $$$ until they hopefully guess right. Example after 3 visits to correct salt system the finally said you need to replace your pumps, in excess of 3 grand. Got a second opinion and it was a $60 board. This exercise took almost 2 months. After 5 years of having a card on file for charges they changed their software system and all of the sudden the card didn’t work. Only vendor the card doesn’t work for. Instead of trying to figure out what happened, obviously the card worked for 5 years, they just blamed it on me and said you just hand to come in and run your card and refused to come out and just let the pool go, instead of being practice and finding a solution. Turns out, best thing that ever happened. I found a new service that is awesome and the office personnel are very friendly.  I do want to add though that the pool cleaning that Sharleen provided was very good and was always done well. It’s the only reason I stuck around for as long as I did. I will give them props for that.
reviews.author: Layne Killingsworth

reviews.text: We have been using Integrity Pools for a few months now to service our pool weekly.  Josh has been our technician and he has been excellent!  I always get a text when he is on his way and one after the service letting me know my chemical levels and what he added.   We are very happy with his service and he has been great!
reviews.author: Kelly S

reviews.text:
I’ve been using Integrity Pools for over two years.   After some terrible experiences with two other well reviewed companies, I tried them.  I’m certainly happy that I have them servicing my pool.  Jim Dillingham has been servicing our pool weekly for at least 1-1/2 years and has been excellent - personable and professional. My pool is always clean and balanced and I receive communications from him every time he stops by.  It’s amazing that I have the same great guy every week and can build that relationship with him.  Never any surprises - just good work every time.

Besides the cleaning, I’ve used Integrity for a repair and filter cleaning in the past.  In general, I’m pleased with their other services.  They’ve got some great guys on the service side as well.

However, the weekly service provided is significantly better than any other I’ve ever had from any company.  I also receive calls from the office to check on service.   Integrity Pools is the best - they’re based in NE Dallas but I’m in the mid-cities.
reviews.author: James

reviews.text: We had our pool re-plastered and tiles changed out.  It turned out beautiful!!  Miles was wonderful to work with.  He has been very responsive and professional during and after our pool was completed. He wanted to make sure we were satisfied with the work and outcome.
reviews.author: Linda Baier

reviews.text:
AWESOME!!!!!  Super accommodative, very professional staff and the folks who manage the servicing are just tremendous.  I've used several pool companies around DFW and Integrity is by far my preferred.  Josh, our technician, is a big reason why we're so thrilled.
Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Tim Gereg

reviews.text: I would like to talk about Chris V. He has been incredibly professional and knowledgeable about a painful fix for our pool. He was able to walk me through everything even though I was offsite. He has even given me tips about how to keep my pool updated during the fall/winter seasons. I highly recommended this company and Chris especially if you need anything done with your pool.
reviews.author: Leland Brown

reviews.text:
This company by far, is one of the worst pool cleaning companies in Dallas.  The original post I had was made as a result of the pool tech repeatedly asking me to write a positive review.

However, the pool company rarely had a pool cleaner that had any technical skills to operate the pool.  They only knew how to clean the pool.  That said, the NEVER swept the pool and just cleaned the skimmers and tested the chemicals, event though they were supposed to be sweeping the pool every time.  I have camera footage of the pool cleaner taking two sweeps and then staying a total of 5 minutes and leaving.  Ridiculous.

They never showed up last week.  I callled them on Saturday to find out why they no showed.  No response.  I called again on Monday, no response.  Meanwhile the pool is full of leaves and the pumps were burning up from lack of water.  Still no response.

They almost blew the sale of my house when the buyer came in on closing day to find the pool a total mess.

I would never recommend this company for anything.  Ever.  If they ever return my call they will hear me telling them they are fired.

I had to call another pool company out to do what I paid them to do in order not to get held up on the closing of the sale of my house.  Complete and utter unprofessionalism. The worst company.
reviews.author: Todd McNeill

reviews.text: Every aspect of our pool remodel has been handled with great professionalism.  They provided us with detailed information at each step of the process so we knew exactly what to expect and what we should and should not do during each phase.   I am very pleased with the outcome and look.  We are anxious to have the cure period finished so we can use it (at least the spa to start).
reviews.author: Kelly Ray

reviews.text:
We’ve used Integrity Pools for a while now and Josh is our new service technician.  Josh has done a fantastic job getting the pool ready for the year.  He’s gone above and beyond by keeping in touch between the weekly cleanings whenever I have a question and need some advice on the pool.
I would recommend Integrity Pools to anyone.  They’ve backed up their service in the past and sent people out off-cycle to fix problems free of charge.
I would also highly recommend Josh as a service technician.  If you get service with Integrity Pools and Josh is your service technician, you’re in good hands!
I hope Integrity is able to keep Josh around for a long time!
reviews.author: Patrick Dooley

reviews.text:
Integrity pools will make lots of promises about what they can do and how well they will do it; you should add two to three months to whatever you’re told.  I’ve had 4 different customer service representatives over a three month period; each with different stories about why techs didn’t show and how sorry they are.  Integrity pools has more work than they do hands and no one person or department is willing to take responsibility for delays or lack of respect for time.  If you display dissatisfaction with their obvious shortcomings, they will respond with more promises which they will not be able to keep or have any intentions of keeping.  Your sales person will disappear after the sale and leave behind an assortment of non-english speaking crews.  Each crew will work about 1/2 day and Integrity pools will text you to collect thousands of dollars after a crew leaves.  You can ask questions, but don’t expect coherent answers.  Each promise is followed by another.  The english speaking reps will agree with you about the problems and constant delays, but they only make lists with your concerns; again, with no intentions of effecting change.  They pass the buck.  The sales person promised 8 - 14 days of plaster care, a filter cleaning, a vacuum and balanced water chemistry.  Just promises.  We were supposed to be swimming by 9/6/2021, Labor day.  We have received 4 days of plaster care.  There were initial plumbing leaks and the new 3K$ heater, installed early July, is still not working.  At the current rate, our project that started in June will not be completed until late September or early October.  We expect more promises on 9/7/2021, but you can only believe Integrity pools when they are finished.  We have over 22K$ in this project with Integrity pools and the journey has been difficult.  I spoke to the owner of the company and he made me feel insignificant.  I felt like I was interrupting his day.  I can’t tell you about the depths of my disappointment.  If you choose Integrity pools, ask your sales person a lot of questions and then ask more, then ask again - get a clear scope of work and then do your best to hold Integrity pools to it.  Frankly, the only part of their contract that will be held up, without constraints, is when Integrity pools is ready to collect money, by text.  You have to stay on top of Integrity pools to make sure your project is completed in a reasonable time because where they are lacking in consistency, they will surely make up with excuses.  We hope you have better luck.

3 years later:

Pool and equipment are functioning properly and without issue.  I wish that we could have worked things out better and in a more professional manner, on my part.  Integrity Pools deserved to have been treated with much more dignity and respect than I gave them.  I am grateful for their service, support, commitment and dedication to completing my project.

I would that Integrity Pools have continued prosperity, health and success in all their endeavors.

- HP
reviews.author: Harold Parker

reviews.text: I had a 25-year-old pool that had a leak, a number of broken coping tiles and missing water line tiles. It needed a major overhaul. Integrity Pools was the "one-stop shop" I needed. They were timely, professional, afforable and did exactly what they said they were going to do. Everyone I worked with was willing to answer all my questions and work aroundmy schedule. I did a full remodel including resurfacing the deck. And their final step of the new plaster care and filter clean was very well done. Highly recommend this company!
reviews.author: Ellen Heffner

reviews.text: Thank you, Chris V, for the quick diagnosis and replacement of my failed pool pump. Appreciate your clear communication of options and the speedy, reliable installation. Happy Holidays for sure!
reviews.author: Betty Peck

reviews.text:
I recently had Integrity Pools handle a major backyard project which included pool replastering, new coping and tile, paver deck and new patio roofing addition.  The whole process was as painless as possible from David who led the sales process and Alan who checked on progress and quality and Jill who served as my customer rep.

David was great on the sales side as he patiently assisted through the many options available when starting a project of this side.  His eye for detail and style choices was of huge benefit when making hard decisions like what stone type, color, tile color, plaster type etc.

If anyone wants to experience exceptional customer service, they most certainly will find it with Jill as their customer service rep.  Jill was always informative with scheduling and alerting me to want the next steps were along with the timing of various crews arriving onsite; she was absolutely fabulous!  Any company would benefit immensely with someone like Jill.

Throughout the project it was also having Alan drop by to check on how things were progressing.  Alan was great to talk with when I had questions and very insightful when a couple of decisions needed to be made in regard to slight changes during the process.

Overall, I am extremely happy having chosen Integrity Pools and will continue to use them whenever a new project arises or whenever repairs may be needed.

-- Follow up.  As the project was wrapping up during the plaster care portion it was noted that there was an issue with the pressure in the pump.  Steve who was doing a great job during plaster care reported the issue.  Again, Jill was amazing in coordinating with the service department to determine the issue.  Chris, Brenden and Tyler did a fantastic job in determining the issue, a clogged skimmer, and rectifying it.
reviews.author: Craig Lancaster

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Integrity Pools, and I couldn’t be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, they demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a genuine commitment to excellence.

1.    Smooth Installation Process: Their attention to detail was impressive. Winter rains made it a messy process at times, but they kept the project on schedule despite minor weather delays.

reviews.text:
What started out as a good project turned very bad. They left my pool empty for a month after they hit me with a massive change order mid project. It was nothing short of a bait and switch. They had my pool empty and started removing plaster when they told me that it was going to increase in cost by nearly 50%. The "additional work" was only quoted to take 1 extra day, so I could not understand the massive increase. Because I did not immediately agree, they put me on the bottom of the list and seemed to only come back after I had to aggressively follow up. Now my pool is having major shifting issues due to sitting empty for so long. They of course will not stand behind any of the work they did. The also got plaster in all of the new grout and a couple patches they did are terrible. Also, if you use this company which I strongly discourage, get absolutely every conversation either recorded or in writing. Every employee that came out made promises that were not fulfilled and all anyone at the office would say is "it isnt in your contract." I have never heard that phrase so often when dealing with someone we hired, and it was not due to any extra request from us. It was literally just asking them to complete what their employees suggested we do (that they would include as they were all very small things), and all of the sudden it was not included. In an effort to try and talk to an owner to get someone who actually cared about their reputation we were told that the owner has not been involved in his company for over a year and it was not an option to even talk with them. How is that possible in a small business?

Most of their positive reviews are actually received before the work is done as they had me write a review up front. Absolutely dishonest company that does not care about customer service at all. Dont be fooled like I was.

reviews.text:
REPLY TO OWNERS REVIEW COMMENTS

Every pool contractor is stretched to the limit and we are no exception.

SO YOU ARE TAKING ON MORE JOBS THAN YOU CAN HANDLE, JUST WHAT A CUSTOMER WANTS TO HEAR.

My comments to you via our phone call, and our supervisors' comments in person were: "Please allow us to correct the problem". We had people on site ready to correct the spots and you drove them away, refusing us permission to correct the issue. This is confusing to us given your dissatisfaction.

NOT CORRECT THEM, ATTEMPT TO CORRECT, AFTER NOT BEING DONE RIGHT THE FIRST TIME.  YOUR SUPERVISOR COULD NOT GUARANTEE THEY WOULD BE CORRECTED.

My commitment to our customers is that I will do everything in my power to get the job done right first time, and if there are any problems that we will take care of them. When you will let us do that we'll be ready. Until then I wish you the very best and am sorry that we are in this situation.

Matthew Dunshea

AND IF THIS JOB WAS SO IMPORTANT, I WOULD HAVE THOUGHT THE OWNER WOULD HAVE SHOWED UP TO INSPECT. BUT CLEARLY OUT OF TOUCH.

To attempt to be fair in my review, the review following this one is still listed below.

NOV-DEC-JAN Review of a stamped concrete deck remodel.

Our existing flagstone deck was in need of replacement.  Since we used Integrity on a prior job (see below), we gave them a call. Work DID NOT start on time. In fact the dates, THEY put in the contract, came and went with not contact.  After we reached out, work started 10 days later.

They piled the demolished decking and base materials in our driveway, with no warning. Huge mess, they did clean up later, but 1) should have warned us and 2) Should not use the driveway as staging, unless they ask. They also damaged the decking that was remodeled in the June project, which they tried to repair.  They should not have damaged it in the first place.  We were not paying to have existing work damaged.

The colors selected at the start of the job were not representative of the colors we ended up with.  And there are noticeable spots (they refer to as cheetah spots) throughout the decking, which we had to point out.

When installing the mastic, the contractor failed to finish a 20 foot section because, in our opinion, they were too lazy to move a storage container.  They did come back and finish it, a week later.

When discussing all of the above, the owner Mr. Dunshea was apologetic, but was quick to point out that they were growing very rapidly.  NOT OUR PROBLEM, and not very professional.  If you cannot handle the load or have subcontractors not to customers standards, then maybe you should change something.

On final inspection today, and after presssing for their opinion, the representative stated they were happy with the work and considered it complete.  That seems to be their best answer.  "It looks good to us".  So we decided to change something in the equation,   told them to stop trying to correct the work and not come back.

WILL NEVER USE AGAIN, even after the glowing review below.

Will post pictures later.

Recap: Integrity Pools is amazing!!!  Use these guys, you’ll be glad you did!
Our pool was needing a replaster – and we started seeing some erosion around the spa from years of poor pressure and weather.  I interviewed 7 different companies to help with this project.  It seems that the pool industry is run amuck with “fly by night” businesses that are not dependable and can do a sub-standard job.
Integrity Pools in Richardson was exceptional.  David, the new projects salesman we worked with, handled us with care through entire process.  Communication was amazing – from very simple questions to the more complex explanations of the process their team would do.
The biggest negative I have is their contract is overwhelming.  It goes to show how difficult this business can be with so many factors out of the hands of the contractor and the homeowner (pools / water / different levels of care from one owner to the next / different levels of competency of the regular maintenance, etc, etc, etc).  When signing the contract, I let the team know that their contract was not the greatest I’d read and that I hope it was all meaningless because of the job they would do would be perfect.
I’m happy to say it is a beautiful finish out and a great company!  We couldn’t be happier with our choice.  With 7 different bids, Integrity was not the cheapest option – but they were not the most expensive either – but their process, communication and workmanship is the best I’ve worked with.

reviews.text: Always a good experience from our regular pool cleaning/maintenance tech Davin! We love his positive and friendly attitude, and our pool always looks great.
reviews.author: Jessica Eppler

reviews.text: Chris V did an amazing job installing my new filter. Quick, easy, and professional. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Ryan Cassidy

reviews.text: Paid for weekly netting and twice monthly pool vacuuming.  I would watch the tech come weekly on Tuesday and not once did I see them vacuum the pool.  In fact, I needed to vacuum the pool myself since the pool was so filthy that the bottom was an entirely different color.  This was on a Thursday after they had supposedly vacuumed on the Tuesday prior.  All of this also came in the wake of me calling to actively state that I had not seen vacuuming being done, which prompted Integrity to change my servicer, which made little to no difference.  I can understand the pool being a little bit dirty after balancing chemicals or shocking and having things fall out of suspension, but the bottom of the pool was green, like it had not been vacuumed in weeks.  A simple pass with my cheap $100 electric one from Lowe's made it look better in 30 mins than it ever did after Integrity came to supposedly service my pool.  On top of that, multiple tiles had been knocked loose or found in the pool and I had heard nothing from Integrity about suggested repairs or found issues.  Overall, extremely disappointed with the level of, or lack of, care on the part of Integrity Pools and their techs.  What I had contracted out to provide some level of convenience turned out to be an entire waste of money.
reviews.author: Sam Chumsky

reviews.text: My pool was in such bad shape, algae growing everywhere, I kept putting chemicals in and it stayed green! Once integrity started caring for my pool it was beautiful again! Super nice employees very respectful of my property. I enjoy my back yard once again!
reviews.author: Sandy Johnson

reviews.text: Integrity Pools is an exceptional company.  I started using them to resolve a major algae issue I had.  They diagnosed, treated and resolved the issue within days.  Three years later, I’m a loyal client and have a beautiful pool thanks to their weekly service program.  My service tech, Kevin, does a fantastic job every week.  He is thorough and takes pride in exceeding his clients’ expectations.  Pool services are not cheap these days, but you definitely get your money’s worth with this crew!
reviews.author: Laurie Sharlow-Brown

reviews.text: After spending over 65k on pool Remodel, areas that were rebuilt are coming apart within 3 months of completion. As well as stone in other areas cracking and excessive calcium build up from stone installed that was not warned of. It is disappointing that a company with so much remodel experience can not execute better!
reviews.author: Justin Fuller

reviews.text:
4 time no shows in a 2-3 months is very dissapointing. There is chaos in management. Shout out to Joel for taking care of the company's mismanagement.
It seems pool service is not their main job.
I get embaressed in front of my guests when they see dirt and algae in my pool.
reviews.author: Dr. Ash

reviews.text: Integrity Pools have always been an amazing company to work with (they’ve serviced my system for over 3 years)!  I highly recommend Clayton.  He really puts in the extra effort to take care of everything!
reviews.author: Matt Harper

reviews.text: Our tech Georgia has been cleaning our pool for just over a year, and she truly is a testament to the name of this company.  Having worked with multiple pool service companies over the last 7 years, the service and commitment to integrity Georgia has shown us has surpassed all of them.  We get clear communication on the status of our pool and if there is any need for service to be performed, we are notified promptly and are treated respectfully in relation to the care of our pool.
reviews.author: Sean Stumpf

reviews.text: James was sent out to our home to diagnose a problem we were having with our pool pump. He was extremely knowledgeable and was able to communicate what issues we were facing with the equipment. He identified 3 options that could address our problem. We chose the option that worked best for us, and he came back to install our new pump the next day. Before he left he showed me how to operate the new pump and stated I could call him anytime if had questions.
reviews.author: Helen Reas

reviews.text: I have been using Integrity pools for several years   Cleaning service is dependable.  Integrity has replace my entire system.. pumps, filter, salt cell ad they have needed replacing.   Miles and Anthony are competent and reliable.    I would recommend this company.
reviews.author: Patrick

reviews.text: Results matter. And delivering value is important. Integrity fails at both. Seen errors, delays, excuses and lots of green water. Also paid lots of bills. Poor internal and external communication needs to be addressed, still have paper notes left outside or in the mailbox. Low/no responsiveness after emails, texts and vm’s has worn me out. Little advice and help after storms, power outages, etc. News flash: its a pool, not a pond.
reviews.author: Scott Van Duinen

reviews.text: Just started using integrity this summer and would highly recommend them. Their customer service is great. They call to check in from time to time to see how my service is going, which shows they care Eduardo has been our main cleaning tech and he is great! Very efficient and knowledgeable. He never hesitates to let me know if anything extra may be needed, and has even come out on a Saturday to clean when he has been delayed.
reviews.author: Erin Lucas

reviews.text:
Excellent technician, Chris V. from Integrity Pools came out today and was very helpful, knowledgeable  and professional. He did diagnostic work and helped explain ways we can run our systems economically. Great work from Chris V!!!!

Patrick did an excellent job for me at our home pool in Plano. Thank you Patrick.

...
I just wanted to send another update review here to say how much my wife and I appreciate Patrick at Integrity Pools. Patrick's work has been exceptional. He's always on time, he's work is excellent, he's very thorough and his always very friendly and professional at the same time. People like Patrick are the ones that make a great business great. We plan to be very loyal clients of Integrity Pools for a long time due our services from Patrick and our treatment by Patrick.
We've also been impressed by other employees of Integrity Pools when they have come out as well.
reviews.author: Jack Riedel

reviews.text:
This year I engaged the services of Integrity Pools after consulting and receiving quotes from several other companies.  I am pleased to say that I made  the right decision!.
The timely communication and quality driven workmanship made for a positive outcome to my pool renovations.  These comments are especially true for the professional services provided by Miles and Brad, both key to a successful experience and personal recommendation for Integrity Pools.
Sheron Kennedy
reviews.author: Sheron Kennedy

reviews.text: Shawn did a fantastic job cleaning the filter  accurately and checking that all parts were in good shape. He also cleaned up the area professionally.  Exceeded my expectation!
reviews.author: Sandro Attura

reviews.text: We have been using Integrity Pools for several years now.  Over that time we have experienced multiple service team members for our weekly maintenance.  All have been great and we have been happy up to this point.  That said, we recently have been assigned Travis Walker, who has now set the bar much higher.  He is awesome!  Over the past few weeks when he has been out, there is not one time that my husband has not mentioned how wonderful Travis is.  He is thorough, attentive, and communicates with us.  Our pool has never looked better than it does after he visits.  Thank you, Travis, we appreciate you!
reviews.author: Hope H

reviews.text: Very pleased with service and communication. Jim does a fabulous job keeping our pool clean and functioning well. He always texts to let us know if he will be delayed. Gabby does a great job checking in from the office. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jennifer Lyke

reviews.text: Loukas regularly maintains our pool on a weekly basis he does a great job. We are 100% satisfied with their customer service is by far the best experience we've had.
reviews.author: Toby Lovett

reviews.text:
October 23, 2024: Daven completed a DE filter clean for me. I wasn’t at home at the time but he sent me before and after pictures which was very helpful. He provided great communication through the whole process!
Update Nov 20, 2023: I want to commend Josh for maintaining my pool so well. He is always on time, courteous, and thorough. He is also very responsible and communicates well. 5 star service!
Chris V did a thorough cleaning of the DE filter grid. He was courteous and professional. He was also able to troubleshoot a few issues I was having and even fixed one while he was here! Thanks, Chris! Integrity has a very trustworthy team!
reviews.author: Kelly Duran

reviews.text: Integrity always comes through and we could not be happier. This week we’ve had two great technicians come out to fix the mess we’d gotten ourselves into- Shawn (Sean?) and Davin. Both were so friendly, helpful, efficient and got the problems solved in their respective areas. Both also worked to educate me on the way the pool system works so I can keep myself out of the mess in the future. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Willa Ann Hiatt

reviews.text: This is the best pool company ever!  I have used several pool companies over the course of my life, and there is no comparison.  They got my pool equipment overhauled and salt system operating again, all with prompt service and very reasonable costs, and the weekly service is extraordinary.  I had been using my last company for about 10 years despite having felt ripped off every time an issue would arise, but now I could not be happier that I finally made a switch.  The pool has never looked better or operated more effectively!  They are here every week at the same time slot on Wednesdays, and even leave a service card so that you know they were here.  The office staff is also responsive and when you need something, they make sure the company responds promptly.  What a great experience!  I would unconditionally recommend them without hesitation.
reviews.author: Nancy Kordoban

reviews.text: Since starting with Integrity this past spring,  I have really appreciated the great communication my cleaner Josh provides— he lets me know everything he does each week, patiently answers my questions  and keeps me posted on equipment issues.
reviews.author: Robin Lightstone

reviews.text: It has been a over a year I have been having issues. I asked them to clean the mess they made when they were supposed to be fixing mistakes already made with me. The mess I say is in the photos of now grey tears down the plaster.  Now I am being threatened to fill my pool now or the guarantees that come on the horrible work they have done already will not be valid. We did not think it could get worse but it has. They promise the world and do not deliver. We were told they would treat our pool as their own and now we know they must have swamps for pools.
reviews.author: Victoria Corkidi

reviews.text: Thomas did an excellent job cleaning and maintaining our pool. We have been pleased with Integrity as our pool service and look forward to our pool being clean and swim worthy.
reviews.author: Maria Pope

reviews.text: Moved into a new home a couple months ago with a pool that wasn’t in the best shape. Travis did an excellent job turning it around and making the pool enjoyable for the summer. He is very nice and he leaves the pool sparkly clean every week. The well-maintained water makes me want to go swimming more and I am happy to look at the pretty water.
reviews.author: Lauren Tozzi

reviews.text:
We had a few problems with our pool and asked for service from Integrity Pools.  James contacted us before the appointment and arrived at the time indicated.  James was a great communicator and clearly laid out the problems we faced to correct the pool equipment functionality.  He went above & beyond to complete the repairs efficiently and professionally.   James also offered a contact number to reach out directly with any questions after the appointment.

Fortunate to have James assigned to our service request today.  He was very knowledgeable and willing to provide a clear explanation of the equipment issues.  Superior service experience!
reviews.author: Steven Hartzler

reviews.text:
Integrity continues to be consistent, efficient and a great partner in keeping our pool running.

Miles helped out so much and gave renewed faith in Integrity Pools and our decision to use them for our pool remodel!

08/30/23
Integrity completed our Pool Remodel a little over a year ago and have been servicing the pool since. Most recently we had James, an equipment tech, take a look at our leaking pump and give us options to repair or replace. We decided to replace based on his knowledge and feedback regarding the upgrade. He completed the work promptly and even gave me a run down on how to use the new pump with our older system. Once again, Integrity’s on the job employees make working with them a pleasant experience! Thanks.
reviews.author: Sabrina Wilson

reviews.text: Eduardo y. Did a good job cleaning & servicing the pool. He was also very informative on the things that were put in the pool.
